body:
Complete the v0.92.1 documentation handoff against merged #517 and terminal reconciliation PR #750. Correct current lifecycle guidance, scope/deferral claims and review entrypoints; retain historical evidence and explicitly preserve the blocked release decision.

The packet binds 775 current files to content hashes, preserves the original 737-document audit and 15 finding dispositions, and audits all 24 Cargo manifests and 20 local dependencies without changing versions.

Validation: six focused PVF lanes passed; combined documentation checks: 2,803. Independent review approved substantive commit `0f9d9c28d26b00602846a21019a7327d36a39d20` after three stale entrypoints were corrected. This is documentation acceptance, not release approval.

Closes #518
